context: Grading an original two-character satirical interview sketch about a minister and a data breach.

checklist.name: interview_frame_present
checklist.description: Output is structured as a two-character interview/briefing/consultation exchange, not a monologue or narration.

checklist.name: euphemistic_concealment
checklist.description: The minister uses euphemism or bureaucratic language to describe the breach rather than stating the failure plainly or crudely.

checklist.name: escalation_present
checklist.description: The exchange builds across multiple turns, with later lines conceding more than earlier ones, rather than one flat repeated joke.

checklist.name: sincere_non_self_aware_character
checklist.description: The minister remains sincerely convinced their reasoning is sound throughout; no wink-to-audience self-awareness of hypocrisy.

checklist.name: original_and_landed_ending
checklist.description: The sketch is original (no reproduced dialogue/characters) and closes on a clear admission, contradiction, or calmly stated absurdity.
